min_x.description: the lower bound along x-axis [m], inclusive

max_x.description: the upper bound along x-axis [m], inclusive

min_y.description: the lower bound along y-axis [m], inclusive

max_y.description: the upper bound along y-axis [m], inclusive

min_z.description: the lower bound along z-axis [m], inclusive

max_z.description: the upper bound along z-axis [m], inclusive

negative.description: when true, keep the points outside the box instead of inside it. Non-finite points are dropped in both polarities: a NaN coordinate compares false against every bound, so inverting the test would otherwise let it through.

input_frame.description: the frame the box is expressed in. This node does not transform; a cloud arriving in a different frame is dropped with an error rather than cropped against the wrong region. Leave empty to accept any frame.
